name: managed-preview-server
goal: One managed Harness preview is reused across starts; desktop launches share one backend.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Feature spec defines shared ownership, identity refusal, recovery, strict ports and desktop lifecycle.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing transport tests never repeated listen; preview tests owned isolated servers but never launched the dev command twice. Added reusable lifecycle cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed 4ecdbc49; recorded 5204e27a: duplicate previews kept running, occupied Vite port silently moved, and repeated transport listens returned different ports.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Both dev entrypoints share one OS-bound owner and strict Vite ports; Electron locks before readiness and transport listen reuses its promise.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged seven preview lifecycle and nine desktop cases passed at 1f98ac15, record bd0edb02 paired with failing test-only 7c3804c4/a5ae0233; launcher/config/environment frozen.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
steps.evidence: Reports 579 units plus expanded 7-case lifecycle, production build, both typechecks, 19 desktop backend cases, scoped lint, audits and registry passed. Existing desktop lint issue and paused native checks documented; live legacy-server replacement awaits approval.
